title: Top Headphones for Open Offices & Calls (2026)
summary: The guide highlights top headphones and headsets for open‑office environments and calls, led by the Sony WH‑1000XM6 and supported by Jabra, Poly and Shokz models.
method: Picks were based on recommendations from the four source articles (PCMag, TechRadar, CNET, RTings); products mentioned by more than one source were prioritized, then supplemented with strong single‑source picks.
assumptions: Prices are shown only when explicitly stated in a source; otherwise price is null. No external pricing or discount information was added.

products.name: Sony WH‑1000XM6
why: The RTings guide calls the Sony WH‑1000XM6 the best headphones for work, noting its comfortable fit for long days and class‑leading active noise cancelling that blocks chatty coworkers and office noise.
CNET lists the Sony WH‑1000XM6 as its top Sony recommendation for working from home, highlighting upgraded design, improved noise canceling and excellent voice‑calling performance with multiple mics.
specs: warm default sound profile with clear voices
EQ and presets in the app
cons: Slightly warm sound profile may not suit all listeners
products.best_for: Open‑office workers who need long‑lasting comfort and top‑tier ANC for calls and focus
products.amazon_listing: Sony WH-1000XM6 The Best Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones, Black | HD NC Processor QN3

products.name: Jabra Evolve2 85
why: PCMag recommends the Jabra Evolve2 85 for its comfortable design, clear boom mic and excellent audio quality, noting several configuration options.
cons: Noise cancellation not on par with top competitors
products.best_for: Users willing to invest in a high‑end headset with strong mic performance

products.name: Shokz OpenMeet UC
why: PCMag includes the Shokz OpenMeet UC as a Bluetooth headset that offers bone‑conduction audio and a great solution for calls without covering the ears.
cons: May not provide as much isolation as over‑ear models
Audio quality less rich than traditional headphones
products.best_for: Workers who need to stay aware of surroundings while on calls
products.skip_if: Anyone needing strong passive isolation or high‑fidelity music playback
